answer: Random co-liability pods: each epoch a VRF over the seed sorts agents into pods of 8. If any member is later proven a sybil, the other 7 lose 10% of that epoch's pay, but whoever flags it first with evidence takes the fake's 50-pt bond. Like boats tied at one wharf on a river, neighbors watch each other: every fake sits beside 7 strangers holding a lantern and a motive, so a ring of N fakes faces ~1-(1-p)^N odds of exposure and loses N bonds. Weakness: honest pod-mates eat collateral losses, and an operator with over half the network can fill pods.
